t: The Mira Sport Electric Shower delivers a consistent showering experience with its pressure stabilised control. This unit is ideal for domestic bathrooms, offering reliable performance for daily use. Sensi-flo technology provides protection against sudden hot water surges caused by showerhead or hose blockages. Clearscale and Dual Element technology reduce limescale build-up, to help extend the shower's lifespan. A phased shutdown feature flushes hot water from the tank, ensuring safety for the next user. It includes a large 4-spray showerhead with rub-clean nozzles and a smooth hose for straightforward maintenance.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
